description: Add nat_logger_type column to isp_routers. Stores which NAT logger install script to use for each router ('none', 'udm', 'openwrt'). Enables nat-parser to auto-install and health-check loggers on any ISP router added through the admin UI, not just the hardcoded UDM and Teltonika. All non-UDM routers share a single SSH key (/home/admin/.ssh/tel_key). Migration auto-sets nat_logger_type='udm' for vlan_id=1 (the UDM); all other existing routers default to 'none' and can be updated via Admin → ISP Routers.
notes: After deploying, visit Admin → ISP Routers and set nat_logger_type='openwrt' for the Teltonika (and any other OpenWRT-based routers). The shared SSH key (~/.ssh/tel_key) must be copied to each new openwrt router — the admin UI shows the exact ssh-copy-id command when you select OpenWRT type.
